title: China Proposes Expanded Export Controls on AI, Biopharma and Solar Energy Technologies
script:
China is expanding its export controls on AI, biopharma, and solar energy technologies. The Ministry of Commerce proposed these new trade restrictions this week.
Beijing wants to tighten government oversight on items deemed critical to national security. These specific sectors now face mandatory licensing requirements for international shipments.
The proposal focuses on technologies in genetic research and solar energy manufacturing. This update follows recent adjustments to the national export control list.
Exporters must now secure formal authorization before moving these regulated assets across borders. This adds a new administrative hurdle for global firms operating inside China.
Will these rules change how you source your tech?
